title: LBIST Pattern Generator (PRPG + Phase Shifter)
constraints: A 16-bit Fibonacci LFSR with polynomial x¹⁶ + x¹⁴ + x¹³ + x¹¹ + 1: each enabled edge shifts left, `state <= {state[14:0], fb}` with `fb = state[15] ^ state[13] ^ state[12] ^ state[10]`.
A phase shifter feeds 4 scan chains (combinational): `chains[0] = s[0]^s[5]`, `chains[1] = s[3]^s[9]`, `chains[2] = s[7]^s[12]`, `chains[3] = s[2]^s[14]`.
hints: Adjacent LFSR bits are the same sequence one cycle apart, so feeding neighbouring scan chains from neighbouring bits makes them highly correlated. XOR-ing taps (the phase shifter) decorrelates them.
This polynomial is maximal-length: the state visits all 65535 non-zero values.
Never load a zero seed: an all-zero Fibonacci LFSR stays zero forever.
